method: Theil–Sen fitted baseline slope through observed flat-bottom anchors, median intercept and measured flat capline. A single uniform physical scale per source page. Lowercase baselines measured independently at the same page scale. No individual glyph-height normalization.

regular-18-n.note: Figures share the same physical printed line as capitals; their differing heights and descenders are preserved.

regular-18-census-n.note: Figures share the same physical printed line as capitals; their differing heights and descenders are preserved.

page_scale.scale_method: One isotropic scale from 13 common capital width/height pairs. Transfer to figure page using repeated header width ratio; no figure height normalization and no row-specific scale.
page_scale.header_transfer_method: 47 matched glyph centers at threshold 130; five-threshold stability check. One scale for both figure-font rows.

header_transfer.method: One isotropic similarity transform from 47 corresponding running-header glyph centers. Letter boundaries mapped at threshold 150 and measured at five thresholds.
header_transfer.visual_review: The retained full running headers have matching construction, wording and spacing. No figure dimensions enter this scale transfer.
header_transfer.threshold_stability: Thresholds 110–170 give 0.46–0.58 native-pixel RMS and scales 1.000874–1.001214. Threshold 90 loses part of a faint glyph and has an 11.85-pixel outlier; it is not used. Selected threshold 130 gives scale 1.00116754, RMS 0.502, maximum 0.903.

caps.method: Measured row baseline and rigid rotation; one fixed physical scale per page from common capitals and matched header centers.

poster-figures.method: Measured row baseline and rigid rotation; one fixed physical scale per page from common capitals and matched header centers.

close-figures.method: Measured row baseline and rigid rotation; one fixed physical scale per page from common capitals and matched header centers.

spaced-figures.method: Measured row baseline and rigid rotation; one fixed physical scale per page from common capitals and matched header centers.

body-00.method: Theil-Sen slope and median intercept of six distributed flat-bottom lowercase letters, threshold 150.

body-06.method: Theil-Sen slope and median intercept of six distributed flat-bottom lowercase letters, threshold 150.

body-08.method: Theil-Sen slope and median intercept of six distributed flat-bottom lowercase letters, threshold 150.

body-10.method: Theil-Sen slope and median intercept of six distributed flat-bottom lowercase letters, threshold 150.

physical_scale.method: One isotropic least-squares page scale from all22 common capitals:44 native rotated width/height measurements. Figures and lowercase excluded from scale fitting.

body-last.method: Nine flat-footed n/h/m/i/r impressions; t excluded because its curved foot overshoots. Figures, round letters and descenders excluded. Theil-Sen slope and median intercept.

handy-figures.note: Short baseline figures 1/2 anchor the first figure group; same heading slope and independent physical scale. Figures 3/4/5 descend. The separate 67890 group includes baseline 7/9 and does not anchor this row.
